routine_json.name: search_nasdaq_symbols
routine_json.description: Searches Nasdaq symbols (stocks, indexes, ETFs) by partial query text using the public autocomplete API, returning a list of matching tickers and associated metadata fields.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Partial search text for the symbol or company name, such as a ticker prefix ("AA") or company name fragment ("Apple"). At least 1–2 characters are recommended for useful results.

routines.name: search_nasdaq_symbols
routines.description: Search Nasdaq symbols (stocks, indexes, ETFs) by partial text query using the public autocomplete API, returning matching tickers and basic metadata.
routines.when_to_use: Use to search nasdaq symbols (stocks, indexes, etfs) by partial text query using the public autocomplete api, returning matching tickers and basic metadata.

routine_json.name: get_nasdaq_basic_quotes
routine_json.description: Fetches basic real-time quote snapshots for one or more Nasdaq symbols using the public https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/basic endpoint, returning date metadata and an array of records with ticker, last sale price, change, percent change, volume, and related fields.

operations.js: (() => { const param = `{{symbols}}`; const parts = param.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); const url = new URL('https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/basic'); for (const p of parts) { url.searchParams.append('symbol', p); } return { builtUrl: url.toString() }; })();

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: One or more Nasdaq symbols with asset class, formatted as a pipe-delimited list separated by commas, e.g. "AAPL|STOCKS" or "AAPL|STOCKS,COMP|INDEX". Use search_nasdaq_symbols to discover valid symbols and asset classes.

routines.name: get_nasdaq_basic_quotes
routines.description: Fetch basic real-time quote snapshots for one or more Nasdaq symbols using the /api/quote/basic endpoint.
routines.when_to_use: Use to fetch basic real-time quote snapshots for one or more nasdaq symbols using the /api/quote/basic endpoint.

routine_json.name: get_nasdaq_symbol_overview
routine_json.description: Retrieves detailed overview metadata and key stats for a single Nasdaq symbol by calling the public /api/quote/{symbol}/info and /api/quote/{symbol}/summary endpoints, returning combined instrument profile and summary statistics.

operations.js: (() => { const infoRaw = sessionStorage.getItem('nasdaq_symbol_info'); const summaryRaw = sessionStorage.getItem('nasdaq_symbol_summary'); const info = infoRaw ? JSON.parse(infoRaw) : null; const summary = summaryRaw ? JSON.parse(summaryRaw) : null; return { symbolOverview: { info, summary } }; })();

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker symbol for the instrument, e.g. "AAPL" for Apple stock or "COMP" for the Nasdaq Composite index. Use search_nasdaq_symbols to discover valid symbols.

parameters.name: asset_class
parameters.description: Asset class for the symbol as used by Nasdaq APIs (e.g. "stocks" or "index"). Obtain this from search_nasdaq_symbols (field asset) and pass in lowercase.

routines.name: get_nasdaq_symbol_overview

routines.when_to_use: Use to retrieve detailed overview/metadata and key stats for a single nasdaq symbol using /api/quote/{symbol}/info and /summary endpoints.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker symbol for the instrument, e.g. "AAPL" for Apple stock or "MSFT" for Microsoft. Use search_nasdaq_symbols to discover valid symbols.

parameters.name: asset_class

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Start date for the historical window in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be on or before to_date.

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: End date for the historical window in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be on or after from_date.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of historical records (rows) to return for the requested date range. Use a reasonable value such as 1000 depending on needs.

routine_json.name: get_nasdaq_news_by_symbol
routine_json.description: Retrieves recent Nasdaq news articles for a given symbol and asset class using the public /api/news/topic/articlebysymbol endpoint, returning the raw data/message/status envelope from Nasdaq including article metadata.

operations.js: (() => { const symbol = `{{symbol}}`.trim().toUpperCase(); const asset = `{{asset_class}}`.trim().toUpperCase(); const q = `${symbol}|${asset}`; const offset = {{offset}}; const limit = {{limit}}; const fallback = 'true'; const url = new URL('https://www.nasdaq.com/api/news/topic/articlebysymbol'); url.searchParams.set('q', q); url.searchParams.set('offset', String(offset)); url.searchParams.set('limit', String(limit)); url.searchParams.set('fallback', fallback); return { builtUrl: url.toString() }; })();

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker symbol for the instrument, e.g. "AAPL" for Apple stock. Use search_nasdaq_symbols to discover valid symbols.

parameters.name: asset_class
parameters.description: Asset class for the symbol as used by Nasdaq news APIs (e.g. "STOCKS" or "INDEX"). Obtain this from search_nasdaq_symbols (field asset) and pass it in uppercase to match observed q parameter format.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first article to return, used for pagination. Use 0 for the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of news articles to return starting from offset.

routines.name: get_nasdaq_news_by_symbol
routines.description: Retrieve recent Nasdaq news articles filtered by symbol using /api/news/topic/articlebysymbol.
routines.when_to_use: Use to retrieve recent nasdaq news articles filtered by symbol using /api/news/topic/articlebysymbol.

usage_guide:
This Nasdaq routine catalog gives you end-to-end coverage for discovering symbols and pulling quotes, fundamentals-style overviews, charts, dividends, historical prices, NOCP series, market-wide status, trending symbols, and symbol-specific news.

Recommended flow:
1) Discover symbols
   - Use search_nasdaq_symbols first when you have partial text (ticker prefix or company name) and need valid Nasdaq instruments.
   - It returns symbol, name, exchange, asset (e.g., STOCKS, INDEX), and industry; use these fields to drive subsequent calls.

2) Get real-time and overview data
   - get_nasdaq_basic_quotes: when you need lightweight, real-time quote snapshots for one or more instruments (last price, change, % change, volume). Pass one or more "SYMBOL|ASSET" pairs (e.g., "AAPL|STOCKS,COMP|INDEX").
   - get_nasdaq_symbol_overview: when you need a rich, single-symbol profile (company name, exchange, market status, key stats, and summary metrics). Pass symbol (e.g., "AAPL") and asset_class (e.g., "stocks" or "index").

3) Time-series and historical pricing
   - get_nasdaq_symbol_chart: for intraday/recent chart time series (timestamps, prices, volumes) suitable for plotting or technical analysis. Pass symbol and asset_class.
   - get_nasdaq_symbol_historical: for daily OHLCV history over a specific calendar window. Pass symbol, asset_class, from_date, to_date, and a row limit.
   - get_nasdaq_symbol_historical_nocp: for recent Nasdaq Closing Price (NOCP) history over a relative timeframe (e.g., last 5 days). Pass symbol and a timeframe code like "d5".

4) Income and dividends
   - get_nasdaq_symbol_dividends: when you need dividend history and related header stats (ex-div date, yield, annual dividend, payout ratio) for a symbol. Pass symbol and asset_class (typically "stocks").

5) Market-wide context
   - get_nasdaq_market_overview: to understand overall U.S. market status and trading session timings (open/closed, countdown, pre/regular/after-hours windows). No parameters.
   - get_nasdaq_trending_symbols: to see which symbols are currently trending by page views for a given asset class (e.g., indexes vs. stocks). Pass asset_class (e.g., "index", "stocks") and a limit.

6) News and research
   - get_nasdaq_news_by_symbol: when you need recent Nasdaq news articles for a given symbol, with pagination. Pass symbol, asset_class (e.g., "STOCKS"), offset, and limit.

Composition tips:
- Typical analysis starts with search_nasdaq_symbols → get_nasdaq_basic_quotes or get_nasdaq_symbol_overview, then branches to historical/NOCP/dividends as needed.
- For dashboards, combine get_nasdaq_market_overview, get_nasdaq_trending_symbols, and a small set of get_nasdaq_basic_quotes calls.
- For research on one name, chain: search_nasdaq_symbols (if needed) → get_nasdaq_symbol_overview → get_nasdaq_symbol_historical (pricing) → get_nasdaq_symbol_dividends (income) → get_nasdaq_news_by_symbol (news flow).
- All routines return Nasdaq’s raw JSON envelopes, so downstream code should inspect data, message, and status.rCode for robust error handling.
